## Specific task description

Task instruction: Grab the flat-bottomed mouse and set it on the Green mat.

Task description: Move the flat-bottomed black mouse on the left side of the table onto the bright-green rectangular mat and align it with the mat’s long edge.

Success criteria: The mouse is near the center of the green mat with its flat bottom against the mat and its long axis aligned with the mat’s long edge. The mouse has been released, and both grippers are open.

## Execution tips

- Approach the mouse from above if possible and grip the flatter side walls around the middle on opposite sides, closing across its short axis. Avoid pressing only on the curved top cover and pushing it away.
- Open slightly wider than the mouse at the grasp point. Before closing, confirm the fingers are outside opposing sidewalls and the pads can contact them, keeping fingertips clear of the table to reduce empty grasps or table impacts.
- If its orientation needs adjustment, first secure it and lift it slightly off the table, then turn where there is enough clearance, avoiding rotation against the tabletop that could make the mouse slide.
- During placement, keep the flat bottom parallel to the mat. Release only after the mat supports the mouse, then withdraw upward to avoid releasing early or shifting it sideways during withdrawal.
